texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。我们现在对他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[This.Owner.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

由于我们残忍的行为带来的恐怖，一部分外星人——现在我们知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们显然拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需求，我们可以部署这些情报对付他们。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the aliens - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

texts.zh:
我们已经完成了对近期捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星生物的研究。这些为数众多的生命体以某种蜂巢思维的方式组织起来，但并没有一个中央的管理实体。相反，这些几乎不具备智慧的个体似乎与它们的整个生物群落形成了一种共生格式塔结构。

与家园以及彼此隔离后，这些共生体退化到了原始状态并迅速消亡，这使得尸检变得相当简单。现在我们已经对他们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]和其他身体部位的内部功能有了很多了解，这为我们[This.Owner.GetResearchers]的遗传学家提供了宝贵的外星生物学数据。

我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. This myriad assortment of lifeforms are organized as a sort of hive mind, albeit without a central, governing entity. Instead these barely-sapient individuals seem to form a mutualistic gestalt with their entire biome.

Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and soon perished, making autopsy rather trivial. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

texts.zh:
我们已经完成了对最近捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。结果表明，它们确实以蜂巢思维的方式组织起来，子个体缺乏自主性或能动性。虽然事实证明对它们进行审讯没有任何作用，但这已变得无关紧要，因为我们已经开始解剖它们。现在我们已经对他们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]和其他身体部位的内部功能有了很多了解，这为我们[This.Owner.GetResearchers]的遗传学家提供了宝贵的外星生物学数据。

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但凭借我们所掌握的生物学知识以及在捕获的飞船上发现的各种线索，我们最终破解了他们的语言和计算机代码。我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues scattered about the captured vessel allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但我们获得的生物学知识以及无人机被劫持时收集到的各种线索，最终让我们破解了它们的语言和计算机代码。我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues gathered when the drones were abducted allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与他们自己的协议相关的信息。但是一旦我们开始将他们大卸八块，我们又可以获得一定的进展了——不仅在了解他们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关他们的更多知识方面。其结论是，他们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对他们使用的攻性数据收集技术，现在他们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在可以同他们的人工智能主体——其自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]——进行沟通，我们会静观其变。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord, but once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We can now also communicate with their parent AI - which calls itself the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - should we see fit.

We now know a great deal about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the [contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。随着两国之间通讯频道的相互公开，事实已经很明显，对方的组织结构是一个蜂巢思维，子个体没有独立行动和决策的能力。尽管审讯对他们毫无用处，但是我们对其开膛破肚，使得我们对其有了诸多方面的了解。我们现在对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部机能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

尽管花费的时间比我们原先希望的要更长，我们获得的生物学知识帮助我们破译了他们的语言——还有他们的计算机代码。若是局势需要，我们可以部署相当数量的情报来对抗他们！
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. As became apparent when they opened communications with us, they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [Root.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we gained helped us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against them, should it prove necessary!

我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与它们自己的协议相关的信息。不过当我们将它们大卸八块，我们就又获得了一定的进展——不仅是在了解它们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关它们的更多知识方面。其结论是，它们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对它们使用的数据侵入收集技术，现在它们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在掌握了数量可观的情报，它们将被投放在合适的时机，来对付它们的人工智能主体——[contact_country.GetName]。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord. Once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We now possess considerable intelligence to deploy against their parent AI, the [contact_country.GetName], should we see fit.
